property_summary: After two successive depositor calls to setL1BlockValues with distinct sequenceNumbers, c.sequenceNumber() must always equal the most recent argument (the field is updatable); the mutant never assigns sequenceNumber, so for any second argument b != 0 it stays stale at 0 and the rule fails.
change_summary: Remove the assignment `sequenceNumber = _sequenceNumber;` so sequenceNumber never gets updated.
